headers.name: x-cacheable
headers.source: https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/web-cloud/web-hosting/cdn-how-to-use-cdn (example response of a domain that runs through the CDN)

headers.name: x-cacheable
headers.source: Observed on 2026-11-06 on auth.service-public.gouv.fr (Not cacheable: uncacheable, and Not cacheable: no cache headers from backend), together with x-cdn-pop-ip
